description.en: Custom firmware mods for the UC Remote 3. Mod 1: configurable charging-screen screensaver with Matrix rain, Starfield, Minimal, Analog, and TV Static themes. Mod 3: compact battery indicator on every entity / activity detail page (v1.4.21 adds a sibling WiFi indicator with a Settings → UI toggle). Mod 4: WiFi UX bundle — live link diagnostics, always-visible signal indicator, reconnect button, WoWLAN toggle on UCR3. Mod 5: Active Session Keeper — resets the device's sleep countdown every 4.5 min via set_power_mode(NORMAL) pings while a media player is actively playing or recent media-control buttons are pressed. Mod 6: Phantom-Wake Suppressor — forces the device back to LOW_POWER if a wake event happens with no user input within a configurable grace window, eliminating WoWLAN-induced phantom-wake battery drain (v1.4.22 fixed the API call format that had silently broken Mod 5/6 since their respective releases; v1.4.23 added recent-input lookback to handle wake-press timing). Wake-replay HUD: post-wake reconnect banner — v1.4.21 made it more prominent (120 px height, font 32, brighter color, subtle pulse).
